guide_solution: (a) The migration of meritorious, skilled and experienced people from one country to another is called brain drain. (b) Lured by the great advantages of developed countries, boys and girls leave their native lands and settle there. (c) Often expert doctors, scientists and engineers go abroad and work there for fat salaries and better service. (d) Brain drain is a great loophole for every country as there is always a scarcity of skilled and talented people. (e) Brain drain being a great curse, the government should create suitable atmosphere in the country to stop it.
